description: Adds or removes Vertica database schema and, optionally, roles with schema access privileges.

parameters.name: cluster
parameters.description: Name of the Vertica cluster. Default: "localhost"

parameters.name: create_roles
parameters.description: Comma separated list of roles to create and grant usage and create access to the schema.

parameters.name: login_password
parameters.description: The password used to authenticate with.

parameters.name: login_user
parameters.description: The username used to authenticate with. Default: "dbadmin"

parameters.name: owner
parameters.description: Name of the user to set as owner of the schema.

parameters.name: port
parameters.description: Vertica cluster port to connect to. Default: "5433"

parameters.name: schema
parameters.description: Name of the schema to add or remove.

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: Whether to create present, or drop absent a schema. Choices: "present" ← (default) "absent"

parameters.name: usage_roles
parameters.description: Comma separated list of roles to create and grant usage access to the schema.

examples:
- name: Creating a new vertica schema
  community.general.vertica_schema: name=schema_name db=db_name state=present

- name: Creating a new schema with specific schema owner
  community.general.vertica_schema: name=schema_name owner=dbowner db=db_name state=present

- name: Creating a new schema with roles
  community.general.vertica_schema: name=schema_name create_roles=schema_name_all usage_roles=schema_name_ro,schema_name_rw
    db=db_name state=present
